question: At the Willow Nursery one bench holds 87 seedlings in one tray and 49 seedlings in a second tray. There are 3 such benches in each greenhouse, and the nursery has 9 greenhouses, all planted the same way. A neighbour then donated a dozen extra seedlings. The nursery is 14 kilometres from town. Every seedling was sold for 5 dollars, and the till prints its totals in cents, but the owner converts everything to dollars before writing it in the ledger. A customer also left a 30-dollar tip. How many dollars did the nursery record altogether?

Each day the Riverside café prepares 213 sandwiches. A supplier delivers 46 extra ready-made sandwiches each day, but 79 sandwiches are set aside every day for a catering contract and never reach the counter. The café puts the rest out for sale each day and sells out, and it does this on each of 7 days. On the last of those days it also sold a special order of 58 sandwiches for a birthday party. The café buys flour in kilograms, but the recipe cards list grams, so the cook converts. The café has been open for a dozen years. How many sandwiches did the café sell over those 7 days?

Jamal won 225 dollars in a raffle. He first spent 93 dollars on a winter coat, whose price tag was printed in cents, though he converted it to dollars before paying. He then shared what was left equally 4 ways between himself and his housemates. Jamal spent 20 dollars of his own share on a takeaway, and later earned 31 dollars for washing cars. He has lived in the house for half a year. How many dollars does Jamal have now from all of this?

The Oakwood theatre has 238 seats, but 90 of them are blocked off for the lighting rig, so only the rest are sold for each performance. A ticket costs 4 dollars, and the box office writes its takings in dollars even though the card machine reports every amount in cents. The play is performed 6 times a week and runs for 3 weeks, selling out every performance. Half the cast are students from the local college. How many dollars did the box office take in over the whole run?

Kim is playing a quiz game and has 205 points. A wrong answer costs her 71 points, and a bonus question then earns her 21 points. The game has 12 levels. Kim then passes through three multiplier gates: at the first gate every point she holds becomes 2 points, at the second gate every point becomes 5 points, and at the final gate every point becomes 2 points again. How many points does Kim have at the end of the game?

Leah manages a warehouse that held 236 boxes of light bulbs on Monday. During the week she received deliveries of 13 boxes, then 49 boxes, and then 35 boxes. Her colleague Marcus, who manages the warehouse next door, received fewer boxes that week than Leah did. Every box contains 8 bulbs. On Friday Leah shipped out 1463 bulbs to a hotel chain. How many bulbs were left in Leah's warehouse?

A juice company had 222 crates of bottles in its warehouse. It shipped 61 crates to a supermarket, and each crate left behind held 9 bottles, so the company recounted its stock in bottles. A quality check found 743 dented bottles, which were thrown out. Every remaining bottle was sold for 7 dollars, and a grateful customer added a 9-dollar tip to that day's total. Over the next 7 days the company took in that same daily amount each day. The morning shift lasted two hours, which is one hundred twenty minutes, and the warehouse has 14 loading docks. How many dollars did the company take in altogether over those 7 days?

Priya had 37 sheets of stickers, more than her friend Leo had. She gave 14 sheets to Leo. Each sheet Priya kept had 6 stickers on it, so she peeled them all off and started counting individual stickers. She used 98 stickers to decorate her notebook. Then Leo handed her 46 stickers back, and her aunt gave her 43 more. Priya now has more stickers than Leo. How many stickers does Priya have now?

Farmer Elsa collected 198 eggs on Monday, while her neighbor Tom collected fewer. She sold 47 eggs at the farm gate, gave 10 to Tom, sold 103 to a bakery, and found that 8 had cracked in the cart. Her hens are 3 years old and lay well. She sold every egg she had left to a cafe at 9 cents apiece, and the cafe owner added a 32-cent tip. How many cents did Elsa receive from the cafe in total?

Jonah practised the piano for 53 minutes on each of 6 days this week. His teacher only counts time spent on new pieces, and 240 of those minutes, four whole hours as Jonah noted, went on scales instead. On Sunday Jonah added 74 more minutes on a new piece. The teacher awards 2 points for every counted minute. Jonah's sister Ruth earned fewer points than he did this week. How many points did Jonah earn?

In the morning Sam arrived at the arcade with 101 dollars, more than his friend Ivy had brought. He found 6 dollars on the floor and added them to his wallet. At the counter he exchanged every dollar he had for 2 tokens each. In the afternoon he spent 82 tokens on racing games and won 5 tokens back from a claw machine. In the evening the arcade ran a happy hour: a bonus machine paid out 8 tokens for every token fed into it, and Sam fed in all of his tokens and kept the payout. Ivy ended the day with fewer tokens than Sam. How many tokens did Sam have at the end of the evening?

A charity fun run had 210 runners registered in each of its 4 age groups. On the day, 73 more runners signed up at the desk. A dozen volunteers handed out water along the route, which was 10 kilometres long. Every runner who took part raised 5 dollars for the charity. After the run, three local shops donated 45 dollars, 35 dollars, and 53 dollars. How many dollars did the charity receive in total?

In the morning a chocolate factory's crew of a dozen workers packed 146 boxes for shipping. In the afternoon they packed 32 more boxes. Every box holds 9 cartons, every carton holds 7 packs, every pack holds 4 bars, and every bar is scored into 8 squares. In the evening the auditor spent ninety minutes, an hour and a half, checking the whole shipment square by square. How many squares of chocolate did the day's boxes contain in total?

At a festival, Rosa's coffee cart served 82 cups in each of the 4 hours it was open on Friday. Each cup was priced at 9 dollars, and Rosa keeps her books in dollars rather than cents, since a hundred cents make a dollar. Across the whole weekend her takings came to triple Friday's total. A regular customer also handed her an 80-dollar tip at closing time. How many dollars did Rosa take in over the weekend, including the tip?

Tom's wallet was empty at the start of the week. He worked 6 days at a bakery and was paid 32 dollars each day, putting every dollar into the wallet. He found 5 dollars on the pavement and added them too. Then he spent 185 dollars from the wallet on a secondhand bike, and his grandmother tucked 9 dollars into it for his birthday. At the fair he fed everything in the wallet into a token machine that gives a token for every 3 dollars. How many tokens did Tom get?

A concert hall has 2 tiers, and each tier has 183 rows with 9 seats in every row. For Saturday's show every seat was sold at 6 dollars. The show ran for one hundred and eighty minutes, that is, three hours. The band has 5 members. The organisers paid 9470 dollars in costs out of the ticket money. How many dollars did the organisers have left after costs?

At half past six in the morning, a newspaper depot sent out 9 carriers, each with 201 papers. By the afternoon, 234 papers had come back unsold and the rest had been sold. The depot earns 8 cents on every paper sold, and it counts its takings in cents even though a hundred cents make a dollar. In the evening the cashier changed all the day's cents into nickels, each nickel being worth 5 cents. How many nickels did the cashier end up with?

Hana set up a lemonade stand in the morning with 104 paper cups, and she sold 41 cups before ten and another 18 by noon. In the afternoon she sold 26 cups to a passing football team and 15 to a group of joggers, and 1 cup blew away in the wind. Each cup of lemonade cost 2 dollars. In the evening her father brought her a fresh pack of 77 cups. Her brother Kai, who ran a stand across the street, sold fewer cups than Hana all day. How many cups did Hana have at the end of the evening?

A scout troop is organised into 14 patrols with 4 scouts in each. Half of the scouts went on the weekend hike, and they were joined by 64 scouts from a neighbouring troop. Every hiker carried 7 litres of water, and the leaders brought an extra 49 litres in a trailer. The trail was 11 kilometres long. How many litres of water did the hiking party carry in total?

A toy factory employed 232 workers and hired 77 more for the holiday rush. Every worker assembles 9 toy cars an hour and works a 5-hour shift each day, three hundred minutes as the notice board puts it. The factory floor has 3 assembly lines. The workers kept this up for 7 days, and a trial batch added 71 more cars. Quality control then rejected 22427 cars. How many cars passed quality control?

In the morning Kira opened a box of 66 glass beads, and 7 of them were cracked, so she threw those away. At the craft market she swapped every good bead for 2 smaller beads. She then divided all the small beads equally between herself and her friend Jun, keeping her own share. In the afternoon she gave 12 of her beads to a younger cousin. In the evening she strung each bead she still had with 2 tiny charms. At the craft fair every charm scores 7 points, and Kira's charms scored more points than Jun's. How many points did Kira's charms score?

In the morning a bakery put out 50 blueberry muffins. By noon 47 had been sold and 2 had been given to the delivery driver. In the afternoon the baker cut every muffin still on the tray into 9 sample pieces, and 2 of the pieces were eaten by the staff. The afternoon baking took ninety minutes, an hour and a half. Each muffin costs 3 dollars. In the evening 5 more sample pieces from a fresh batch were added to the sample plate. How many sample pieces were on the plate at the end of the evening?

In the morning Ravi's manuscript stood at 43 pages. Before lunch he wrote 23 more pages, and after lunch another 46 pages. In the afternoon he printed 4 copies of every page and stacked all the printed sheets on his desk, a job that took two hours, one hundred and twenty minutes. He then added 31 printed cover sheets to the same stack. In the evening he mailed 292 sheets from the stack to his publisher. How many printed sheets were left on Ravi's desk?

In the morning a plant nursery had 199 seed trays on its benches. It sold 73 trays to a landscaper and threw out 23 trays that had dried up. In the afternoon a delivery brought 17 fresh trays. In the evening the manager counted the stock seedling by seedling: every tray holds 6 rows, and every row holds 9 seedlings. How many seedlings did the nursery have at the evening count?

In the morning Owen's taco truck made 111 tacos in each of 4 busy hours, all of which went into the warmer. In the afternoon the crew made 37 more, then 17 more, then a final batch of 75, adding them all to the warmer. In the evening 74 tacos that had gone cold were thrown out. Owen's rival Bella made fewer tacos in her truck that day. Counting everything that went into the warmer minus what was thrown out, how many tacos did Owen's truck have for sale that day?
